pins.name: CCW
pins.description: track end 1 (Bourns' schematic: 1): the end the wiper nears turned counter-clockwise, by the usual convention

pins.name: CW
pins.description: track end 3 (Bourns: 3): the end the wiper nears turned clockwise

pins.name: MP
pins.description: the two metal mounting tabs (soldered for strength; may go to GND for shielding or stay unconnected)

notes: Into an ADC (a knob, a setting): CCW to GND, CW to the ADC's reference supply (3.3 V), W to the analog input; turning clockwise raises the reading. Add 100 nF from W to GND against noise.

Bourns' schematic numbers the track's ends 1 and 3 without naming the direction; CCW and CW follow the usual convention (pin 1 at left seen from the shaft side with the pins toward you). If it reads backwards, swap the ends in the design.
B in the order number is the linear taper, A audio (log); 103 = 10 kΩ. Option digit 2 (PTV09A-42…) adds a centre detent.
The same 9 mm footprint size as the Alps RK09K family's vertical pots (pins at 2.5 mm, tabs at the sides); check another maker's drawing before using this footprint for it.
